steps.summary: Follow the cobblestone road South-West from Town straight to The Crossroads
steps.layout_tell: Optional: Pick up Dirty Lockbox (Silver Locket for Weylam's flask reward) in the ruined fort along the road.
steps.next_exit: Enter The Crossroads → Tag Waypoint immediately
steps.portal_tip: Stay on the road the entire way

actions.text: Follow cobblestone road SW (loot Silver Locket if you want a utility flask)
Enter The Crossroads & tag the Waypoint

steps.gem_reward: Silver Locket gives a Jade/Granite/Quartz Flask from Weylam.

variants.title: SW Road
variants.desc: Direct road from Bridge Encampment to Crossroads.

steps.summary: Tag Crossroads WP → Go SE through Fellshrine into The Crypt → Do Cruel Trial #2 on Lvl 1 → Loot Maligaro's Map on Lvl 2
steps.layout_tell: In The Crypt Level 1: find both Cruel Lab Trial #2 and the Sarcophagus stairs to Level 2.
steps.next_exit: Loot Maligaro's Map in Crypt Lvl 2 → Logout to Town → Take WP to Crossroads → Go NW to Chamber of Sins
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after looting Maligaro's Map from the Container of Sins in Level 2!

actions.text: Tag Crossroads WP → Run SE through Fellshrine into The Crypt
On Crypt Level 1: Complete Cruel Lab Trial #2 & open Sarcophagus to Lvl 2
On Crypt Level 2: Loot Maligaro's Map → Logout → WP to Crossroads (go NW)

steps.gem_reward: Maligaro's Map is required to open Maligaro's Sanctum in Chamber of Sins.

variants.title: 4-Corner Crypt
variants.desc: Loop outer hallways to reveal Trial and Sarcophagus stairs.

steps.summary: Tag WP → Put Maligaro's Map in Device → Kill Maligaro for Venom → Trade to Silk → Take hallway Map Device points to!
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ MAP DEVICE TELL: The broken carpet & Map Device in the center room ALWAYS point down the hallway to Level 2!
steps.next_exit: Kill Maligaro → Trade Black Venom to Silk for Obsidian Key → Enter Chamber of Sins Level 2
steps.portal_tip: In Maligaro's Sanctum, hug island edges until you see TWO bridges side-by-side leading to Maligaro's Workshop!

actions.text: Tag WP & insert Maligaro's Map into the Map Device
Enter Sanctum → Kill Maligaro → Loot Black Venom
Give Black Venom to Silk for Obsidian Key → Take Map Device hallway to Lvl 2

steps.boss_info: Maligaro, the Artist: Summons Fidelitas & Chaos degens; avoid Chaos rune traps on the ground.
steps.gem_reward: Obsidian Key opens the secret passage in Level 2.

variants.title: Center Compass Room
variants.desc: Map Device orientation guarantees you pick the right hallway.

steps.summary: Complete Cruel Lab Trial #3 (Cruel Lab 3/3!) → Find long narrow hallway & open Secret Passage with Obsidian Key → Enter The Den
steps.layout_tell: Cruel Trial #3 is usually in the North-East/South-East wing; the Secret Passage to The Den is at the end of a long narrow bridge hallway.
steps.next_exit: Complete Cruel Trial #3 → Open Secret Passage → Traverse The Den into The Ashen Fields
steps.portal_tip: Once Cruel Trial #3 is done, you have all 3 Trials for Cruel Labyrinth!

actions.text: Complete Cruel Lab Trial #3 (Sawblades & Spikes — 3/3 Cruel Trials!)
Use Obsidian Key on Secret Passage → Run through The Den into The Ashen Fields

variants.title: Trial + Secret Tunnel
variants.desc: Secret tunnel replaces Fidelitas's arena from Act 2.

steps.compass: FOLLOW ROAD SW → KILL GREUST (+1 PT)
steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Follow road South-West into The Fortress Encampment → Kill Ralakesh/Greust (+1 Skill Pt!) → Enter Northern Forest
steps.layout_tell: Follow the road/fence West/South-West straight into Greust's palisade arena.
steps.next_exit: Kill Greust (+1 Skill Pt!) → Exit West of arena into The Northern Forest
steps.portal_tip: Hide behind the stone pillars inside Greust's arena when he fires his green spear barrage!

actions.text: Tag Waypoint & follow the path SW to The Fortress Encampment
Kill Greust, Lord of the Forest (+1 Passive Skill Point!)
Exit West out of the arena into The Northern Forest

steps.boss_info: Greust / Ralakesh: Heavy Physical spear barrage. Stand behind stone pillars during his channeled volley!
steps.gem_reward: The Master of a Million Faces (Eramir): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: SW Palisade
variants.desc: Arena sits between Ashen Fields and Northern Forest.

steps.summary: From Northern Forest enter The Dread Thicket → Collect all 7 Fireflies → Kill Gruthkul in Den of Despair (+1 Skill Pt!)
steps.layout_tell: Loop around the outer circle of Dread Thicket to grab all 7 Fireflies; Gruthkul's cave (Den of Despair) is usually near the center/inner ring.
steps.next_exit: Collect 7 Fireflies + Kill Gruthkul (+1 Pt) → Exit Dread Thicket & head North in Northern Forest to The Causeway
steps.portal_tip: Make sure your quest tracker says 7/7 Fireflies before leaving The Dread Thicket!

actions.text: Click all 7 Firefly shrines scattered around The Dread Thicket
Enter Den of Despair → Kill Gruthkul, Mother of Despair (+1 Skill Pt!)
Return to Northern Forest & head North-East to The Causeway

steps.boss_info: Gruthkul, Mother of Despair: Heavy Physical/Bleed slams & slowing black projectiles. Keep moving!
steps.gem_reward: Queen of Despair (Eramir in Town): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Circular Thicket
variants.desc: Sweep outer loop for 7 Fireflies and inner cave for Gruthkul.

steps.summary: Run North-East up the stone causeway → Tag WP → Loot Kishara's Star right before the exit (+1 Skill Pt!) → Enter Vaal City
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ KISHARA'S STAR TELL: Kishara's Lockbox (+1 Skill Point) is ALWAYS 1 screen before the Vaal City exit gate!
steps.next_exit: Loot Kishara's Star (+1 Pt) at end of zone → Enter The Vaal City
steps.portal_tip: Never exit The Causeway without clicking Kishara's Lockbox right next to the exit stairs!

actions.text: Run North-East along the ruined stone causeway & tag Waypoint
Click Kishara's Lockbox right before the exit stairs (+1 Skill Pt!)
Enter The Vaal City

steps.gem_reward: Kishara's Star (Weylam Roth): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Linear NE Bridge
variants.desc: Star is guaranteed right next to the top-right exit.

steps.summary: Hug outer brick perimeter until you find a narrow dead-end alley pointing INWARD → Follow its direction to Center WP & Yeena!
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ VAAL CITY TELL: Do not wander the maze! Run along the outer wall until you see a tiny dead-end nook pointing toward the middle — walk straight inward from there to find Yeena!
steps.next_exit: Talk to Yeena (7 Fireflies) → Tag WP → Enter The Temple of Decay Level 1
steps.portal_tip: Teleport to Town from Vaal City WP to claim your +3 Passive Skill Points from Eramir & Weylam!

actions.text: Find central snake temple → Tag Waypoint & talk to Yeena
Descend into The Temple of Decay Level 1

variants.title: Center Snake Temple
variants.desc: Yeena and the WP are always near the center of the city.

steps.summary: Descend through Temple of Decay Level 1 & Level 2 → Kill Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows → Exit to Sarn Ramparts (Act 8)
steps.layout_tell: In Temple of Decay, each sub-floor stairs is in the opposite corner from where you entered.
steps.next_exit: Kill Arakaali → Walk out into The Sarn Ramparts (Act 8)
steps.portal_tip: In Arakaali's fight, watch which side she turns her head toward — she fires her laser barrage to THAT side!

actions.text: Navigate through Temple of Decay Level 1 and Level 2
Kill Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows (Chaos/Lightning lasers)
Exit north into The Sarn Ramparts (Act 8)

steps.boss_info: Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows: Heavy Chaos & Lightning lasers + Spider web barrages.
steps.gem_reward: Completes Act 7 and unlocks Major Pantheon: Soul of Arakaali (Chaos DoT reduction!).

variants.title: Corner-to-Corner Floors
variants.desc: Move diagonally across each web sub-floor.
